abstract: BACKGROUND: Teratoma is the second most common mediastinal neoplasm, but malignant transformation in mature teratomas is uncommon, and cases of carcinoid tumor with teratoma are described in only a few studies. In addition, multilocular thymic cyst associated with mature mediastinal teratoma is also a rare entity. There have been no reports of case with the coexistence of these three pathological lesions. CASE PRESENTATION: The patient was a 24-year-old man who was referred to our hospital due to a 2-day history of left shoulder pain, a feeling of severe chest tightness and high fever. Pre-operative computed tomography (CT) showed a large, fluid-filled and well-demarcated multilocular cyst in the anterior to superior mediastinum measuring up to 12 cm in size. Contrast-enhanced CT also revealed that the tumor contained a solid component with slight contrast enhancement and spotty wall-thickening septation. Therefore, cystic thymoma, thymic cyst, cystic teratoma, or germ cell tumor with an inflammatory reaction were considered as differential diagnoses. The patient underwent tumor extirpation under median sternotomy. The pathological diagnosis was multilocular thymic cyst with mature teratoma including carcinoid tumor (Grade 2) in the mediastinum. CONCLUSIONS: The relationship between thymic cyst, teratoma and carcinoid tumor is unclear at present; therefore, further research is needed to clarify the relationship between these entities. In this report, we present a case of multilocular thymic cyst with mature teratoma including a carcinoid component in the mediastinum that was detected by complete surgical resection.
abstract_ja: 背景：奇形腫は縦隔腫瘍の中で2番目に多い。しかし、縦隔の成熟奇形腫における悪性転化は稀であり、奇形腫を伴うカルチノイド腫瘍の症例は数編の研究でしか報告されていない。また、成熟縦隔奇形腫に関連する多房性胸腺嚢胞もまれな病態である。これら3つの病理学的病変が併存した報告はこれまでにない。症例提示：24歳男性が、2日間の左肩痛、強い胸部圧迫感、高熱を主訴に当院を紹介された。術前の胸部CTでは、前上縦隔に最大12cmの、液体で満たされた境界明瞭な多房性嚢胞が認められた。造影CTでは、腫瘍にわずかに造影される充実性成分と、斑状の壁肥厚および隔壁が認められた。そのため、嚢胞性胸腺腫、胸腺嚢胞、嚢胞性奇形腫、または炎症反応を伴う胚細胞腫瘍が鑑別診断として考えられた。胸骨正中切開下に腫瘍摘出術を施行した。病理学的診断は、縦隔の成熟奇形腫にカルチノイド腫瘍(Grade 2)を伴う多房性胸腺嚢胞であった。結論：胸腺嚢胞、奇形腫、カルチノイド腫瘍の関係は現時点では不明確であり、これらの疾患概念の関連を明らかにするためにはさらなる研究が必要である。本報告では、完全な外科的切除により検出された、縦隔の成熟奇形腫にカルチノイド成分を伴う多房性胸腺嚢胞の症例を提示する。
